name: Emilio Herrera Lozano
bio: Herrera is Spanish for blacksmith — so the name kind of chose the brand. I'm a Product Engineer who forges software end to end: polished interfaces, serverless backends, and AI features built on LLM workflows and agentic systems.

Today I design and ship product features at Finsphera. In my free time I run Blacksmith Softworks, a small studio making web apps, tools, and games. My roots are in Game & Interactive Media Design, which is why I sweat the details people feel but never quite notice.

points: Designed and shipped product features end to end — from UI/UX and serverless backend architecture to infrastructure.
Built AI-driven features with LLM workflows and agentic systems to automate the complex parts of the app.
Crafted responsive, high-performance web interfaces with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS.
A studio for software that's useful and fun — from web apps to video games.
Built the community website (Wix + design in Figma).
Designed social media content to grow the brand and keep the community talking.

education.degree: Bachelor's, Game and Interactive Media Design
